incentives.name: Sales tax exemption for qualifying datacenters (electricity and datacenter support equipment)
incentives.what: Exempts electricity used at, and support equipment (power, HVAC, servers, software) located at, a qualifying datacenter. Qualifying: Commerce Secretary finds at least $75M private investment within five years (investment on or after Jan. 1, 2012), wage standard by development tier (none in tier one), and health insurance for full-time staff. Forfeited if investment not timely made.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 730 Ratepayer Protection Act
laws_and_bills.what: Data centers with 100 MW+ peak demand: noise and air assessments before zoning, ban on local tax incentives, water-recycling cooling, minimum contracts and billing to protect households, study of rates and climate goals. Passed Senate 2nd reading May 2025; House passed committee substitute 69-44 on June 3, 2026; referred to Senate Rules June 8, 2026 for concurrence.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1063 Ratepayer and Resource Protection Act
laws_and_bills.what: Data centers 40 MW+: end sales tax exemption and other incentives, pay full marginal cost of grid upgrades, on-site clean generation, annual DEQ reports on power, water and cooling.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 844 Affordable Energy Omnibus
laws_and_bills.what: Data centers 50 MW+: utilities must create large-load tariffs, environmental reviews, local referendums on projects.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1180 Data Center Amendments
laws_and_bills.what: Data centers over 20 MW: Utilities Commission to create tariffs with 10-year minimum contracts, minimum billing, financial assurance, notice before load cuts.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1189 Data Center Transparency Act
laws_and_bills.what: Bipartisan: eliminate data center sales tax exemptions and impose a two-year moratorium on state permits and approvals for siting data centers.

dockets.what: Rate case where AG and Public Staff push a large-load tariff (50 MW+, minimum bills, exit fees, curtailment hours). Duke has contracts with 16 energy-intensive customers totaling 4,337 MW. Settlement proposed; AG declined to sign. Docket number confirmed from the Oct. 6, 2026 large load tariff settlement filing.

dockets.id: E-7, Sub 1329 and E-2, Sub 1380 (large load tariff)
dockets.utility: Duke Energy Carolinas / Duke Energy Progress
dockets.what: Large load tariff handled inside the two rate cases (Microsoft's June 8, 2026 request for a separate docket was taken under advisement). Commission asked for comments Aug. 12 and 14, 2026 on a model rate schedule. Oct. 6, 2026: Duke filed a large load tariff settlement with the Public Staff, Amazon Data Services, Andale LLC, CIGFUR II and III, DOD/federal agencies, Google and Microsoft: minimum contract 10 years (under 100 MW) or 15 years (100 MW+), minimum billing demand, letters of credit for network upgrades, liquidated damages on early exit. SELC's clients (NC Justice Center, NC Housing Coalition, SACE, Vote Solar) say upfront payments and exit fees are too low.
dockets.status: settlement filed Oct. 6, 2026; awaiting Commission order

dockets.what: AG asks for a separate rate class for data centers and large users; opposes proposed 15% increase. Docket number confirmed from the Oct. 6, 2026 large load tariff settlement filing.
